title: IPC Office Memorandum No. IPC/1064/2020-21 for effective use of ‘Aarogyasetu’ app for breaking the chain of transmission of COVID-19.
bodyHtml: With reference to the OFFICE MEMORANDUM NO. 11013/9/2014-ESTT (A.III) dated 29-04-2020 issued by M/o Personnel, Public Grievance and Pensions, Department of Personnel & Training, New Delhi. IPC also issued an Office Memorandum No. IPC/1064/2020-21 for effective use of ‘Aarogyasetu’ app for breaking the chain of transmission of COVID-19.PDF (opens in a new tab) (Please Click)
